def minChar(S: str) -> int:
    n = len(S)
    rev_S = S[::-1]
    combined = S + "#" + rev_S
    lps = [0] * len(combined)
    
    # Compute LPS array
    j = 0
    for i in range(1, len(combined)):
        while (j > 0 and combined[i] != combined[j]):
            j = lps[j - 1]
        
        if combined[i] == combined[j]:
            j += 1
            lps[i] = j
    
    return n - lps[-1]
